{
  "dataset_name": "mozilla4",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "duration",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between end and start positions, representing the span of the record.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2000000.0],
      "feature_family": "interval",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous linear-margin signal of record span magnitude.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "end - start"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_duration",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled duration to compress heavy-tailed span distribution into a smooth feature.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "interval_scaled",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth normalized scale improves linear SVM margin separation across order-of-magnitude differences.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.maximum(end - start, 0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_size",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed size to reduce skew of the long-tailed size column.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "scaled_magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linearizes multiplicative size effects useful for SVM hyperplane fitting.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(size)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_start",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed start position to compress its dynamic range.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "scaled_magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth scaled position aids linear separability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(start)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_end",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed end position to compress its dynamic range.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "scaled_magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smoother scale supports linear projection.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(end)"
    },
    {
      "name": "size_per_duration",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of size to duration giving density-like measure.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10000.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures intensity per unit span, useful as linear feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "size / (end - start + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_size_per_duration",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-compressed size-to-duration density.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio_scaled",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth log-density gives near-linear separating signal.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(size / (end - start + 1.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "start_end_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of start to end positions, normalized to [0,1] when start <= end.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.5],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized positional ratio gives bounded linear feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "start / (end + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "event_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Pass-through of the binary event indicator as a numeric feature.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Direct binary covariate for the linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "event * 1.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "event_times_log_duration",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction between event indicator and log duration.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows linear SVM to weight duration differently when event occurs.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "event * np.log1p(np.maximum(end - start, 0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "id_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Row id normalized to approximately [0,1] using training-set max id constant.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized_position",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides smooth ordered position feature for linear projection.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(id / 4088.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "size_severity_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic severity judgment of the size value mapped to a smooth 0-1 score using log-scaled thresholds: trivial (<10), small (10-100), moderate (100-500), large (500-2000), extreme (>2000), expressed as clipped log ratio.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "severity_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a bounded smooth severity proxy aligned with linear SVM weighting of magnitude regimes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.log1p(size) / np.log1p(12363.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    }
  ]
}
